Tool: built-in image_gen, imagegen skill. One transparent effect atlas generated for this project.
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production transparent PNG animation sprite atlas for a 16-bit Korean fantasy action RPG. Exactly 4 equal columns x 4 equal rows, a square 1024x1024 sheet. Each cell is a separate centered effect with generous completely transparent margin, no overlapping cells, no labels, no gridlines. Every row contains 4 consecutive animation frames of the same effect at the same scale (onset, peak, spreading, fading). Row 1: dark crimson blood ribbons sweeping in a curved scythe slash, red droplets and a bright scarlet edge, physical liquid rather than fire, flowing into a central point. Row 2: precise silver-white execution cut with deep crimson aftercut, a strong diagonal cleaver slash and sharp pinpoint metal sparks, crisp thin blade edge, not a giant magic emblem. Row 3: top-down three-quarter GROUND earthquake impact, branched jagged cracks revealing warm ochre stone, rock shards lifting a short distance and dusty ground shock, spreading outward; no meteor, no fire, no falling object, no planet. Row 4: horizontal rightward armored ram impact, short steel-blue friction sparks, bent metal fragments and compressed white shock streaks, no shield icon, no magic seal. Crisp expertly shaded pixel art with dark pixel edges, luminous highlights and rich texture, matching polished pixel RPG battle sprites. Effects only: no characters, animals, weapons, symbols, circles, scenery, text or watermark. Empty pixels genuinely alpha transparent, not a white or black rectangle.
Integration: scripts/build-rpg-warrior-impact.py slices four rows and four stages from the actual generated dimensions and packs transparent frames into a 1024x1024 game atlas. Source alpha is retained. GIF previews use a green background only; the game uses the transparent PNG.
